cards.altText: Which bioinformatics door should you open? Start with your question. Then choose your route. Three elegant dimensional paper doors, each revealing DNA ribbon, RNA strands or a protein fold. Maroon big headline dominates.
cards.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Create ONE finished Instagram carousel card, SQUARE 1:1 aspect ratio, exactly 1080×1080 requested. Full bleed, 80px safe margins. Professional creative attractive scroll-stopper editorial design with dimensional tactile scientific objects. Readable on phone: very large expressive serif headline and clear sans-serif body, generous spacing. Top small brand ANGSUMI, bottom @angsumi.online and card number. Render ONLY supplied exact text and necessary labels; no added slogans, equations, numbers, fake data, citations, logos or watermark. Conceptual illustrations must not look like computed experimental results. Never combine multiple cards in one image. Series Bioinformatics subdomains. Style: Surreal tactile paper laboratory: warm ivory paper, maroon expressive serif, sage and forest accents. Metaphor: dimensional paper doors opening into different scientific questions. Card 1/6. Exact headline: "Which bioinformatics door
should you open?". Exact body: "Start with your question.
Then choose your route.". Visual direction: Three elegant dimensional paper doors, each revealing DNA ribbon, RNA strands or a protein fold. Maroon big headline dominates.. Footer numbering "1/6".
